Text roguelite â€” three rounds, left to right then next row. 480Ã—800 portrait, same header / 30px inverted list rows / 106px hint boxes as the chess canvas.
One redraw per Confirm. Narrative on top, choices pinned above the hints so the cursor is always in the same place.

The loop:
1. Room â€” narrative + 2-4 choices. Up/Down move, Confirm picks.
2. A choice either resolves inline (event), opens Combat, or Descends (depth+1, new room).
3. Combat â€” Attack / Defend / Item / Flee, one turn per Confirm, 3-line log. Ends in loot + Continue, or death.
4. Back opens Pause; Abandon ends the run. Power-off mid-run resumes from the same screen.
Turn counter ticks on every action; seed in the header so a run can be retold.
Combat log is a fixed 3-line box so the layout never shifts between turns â€” only the numbers change, so a fast (partial) refresh is enough.

Clickable. Play it with the four buttons under the screen (or click rows / hint boxes). Same three rounds as the storyboard, plus a fourth room with a boss; combat math is fixed for the prototype, not random.
